title: Export current-page order and unlinked receipt amount summaries to PDF
description: A sales user downloads the chosen current-page order and unlinked-receipt amount summaries in the existing paged Chinese PDF. For supported customerCurrency SummaryMode, reuse ERP-172 summary DTOs from the same bounded authorized page and append separate order-amount and unlinked-receipt-amount sections; none preserves existing sections and count groups. Recheck current-user sales-order menu and salesperson scope on every export, reject invalid modes before source reads, retain OperationLogMiddleware download audit and existing explicit SimHei failure. Show unknown, empty and receipt-truncation evidence; keep pending/historical receipts separate. Never join receipts to orders, infer allocation/receivable balance, merge currencies, or turn null into zero. Development only: no arbitrary SQL, schema/migrations, production SQL or real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused PDF tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF export validates SummaryMode before source reads and reuses the ERP-172 authorized bounded current page; none preserves the existing evidence and optional count-group sections.

customerCurrency appends distinct order-amount and unlinked-receipt-amount PDF sections with customer, original currency, receipt evidence status, known/unknown counts, explicit unknown/empty/truncation text and bounded pagination; missing SimHei fails visibly.

PDF tests cover denial, invalid mode, multiple currencies, null amounts, pending/historical receipts, long labels, pagination, empty/truncated results, font failure and unchanged evidence sections; document the current-page boundary and pass safe Release build/test.
